verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents automatic user provisioning, so changes to Workspace user accounts sync to connected third-party apps (Office 365 example). It also documents SAML SSO for company cloud apps and remote wipe of a user's account from mobile devices, which together support centralized offboarding. However, nothing in the pack shows that suspending a user revokes active sessions, that deprovisioning happens immediately, or that this all happens as one action. Missing for 10: documented session revocation on suspension, evidence of immediate (not delayed-sync) deprovisioning across apps, breadth of SCIM-connected apps beyond the one example, independent corroboration.
